mapper.sql: select ctrf_llave as llaveTabla ,ctrf_nombre as nombre ,ctrf_tiporecurso as tipoRecurso ,(select cdpl_nombre from documentoplantilla_dplp where cdpl_llave = ctrf_tiporecurso) as tipoRecursoNombre ,ctrf_tipodimension2 as tipoDimension2 ,(select cdpl_nombre from documentoplantilla_dplp where cdpl_llave = ctrf_tipodimension2) as tipoDimension2Nombre ,ctrf_tipodimension3 as tipoDimension3 ,(select cdpl_nombre from documentoplantilla_dplp where cdpl_llave = ctrf_tipodimension3) as tipoDimension3Nombre ,ctrf_tipodimension4 as tipoDimension4 ,(select cdpl_nombre from documentoplantilla_dplp where cdpl_llave = ctrf_tipodimension4) as tipoDimension4Nombre ,btrf_productoopcional as productoOpcional ,btrf_rangovalores as rangoValores ,btrf_rangocantidad as rangoCantidad ,ctrf_estado as estado from tarifario_trfp a
